subject: Botany
exam_context: NEET UG 2026 - Botany half of the Biology section, conventionally 45 scored questions / 180 marks (Biology overall: 90 scored questions / 360 marks, split evenly between Botany and Zoology by most coaching trackers)
data_provenance: Estimated from PYQ-trend analysis and chapter-wise-weightage trackers aggregated across 2025 and 2026 NEET sessions (including the 21 June 2026 Re-NEET UG), not official NTA data; last grounded Sep 2026. NTA does not publish a separate Botany/Zoology split, so figures here reflect the conventional coaching-tracker split and multi-session averages, not a guarantee of any single paper's composition.

B01.notes: Direct NCERT-line classification and terminology questions; a reliable easy-marks area, especially Plant Kingdom.

B02.notes: Morphology/anatomy diagram-and-terminology questions recur; a scoring but detail-heavy area.

B03.notes: Cell organelle function and mitosis/meiosis stage-identification questions are a consistently high-weightage archetype.

B04.notes: Photosynthesis and respiration pathway/enzyme questions recur across sessions; a broad, high-yield unit.

B05.notes: Pollination and post-fertilisation development questions recur.

B06.notes: Repeatedly flagged by trackers as the single highest-weightage Biology chapter (~12-14% in some analyses); replication/transcription/translation and lac-operon questions dominate.

B07.notes: Direct NCERT-fact recall on applications of microbes; a reliable easy-marks chapter.

B08.notes: Consistently flagged as a top-3 Biology chapter; restriction-enzyme/PCR/Bt-crop questions recur every session.

B09.notes: Ecological-pyramid, population-interaction and conservation-terminology questions recur; a broad, generally easy-to-medium unit.

broad_category_weightage_pct.note: Coarser cross-check figures, approximate % share of the 45-question scored Botany half, synthesised from multiple 2025-2026 PYQ trend sources. Rounds do not sum exactly to 100%.

marking_scheme.source_note: Confirmed via multiple Sep 2026 sources reporting on the 2026 and Re-NEET UG 2026 (21 June 2026) sessions.
marking_scheme.section_a_share: Biology Section A has 70 single-correct MCQs, all compulsory (conventionally ~35 Botany-origin); +4 correct, -1 incorrect, 0 unattempted.
marking_scheme.section_b_share: Biology Section B has 30 single-correct MCQs, attempt any 20, best 20 scored (conventionally ~15 Botany-origin); +4 correct, -1 incorrect, 0 unattempted.
